About the role:

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Commercial Counsel to join our team. Reporting to the General Counsel, you will play an important role in managing the Company’s commercial transactions from end-to-end, including review, drafting and negotiation of agreements, advising internal stakeholders on risks and business goals, and developing, improving and scaling processes and systems related to contract management. You will also provide generalist support for day-to-day legal issues on an as-needed basis.

What you will do:

- Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including master service agreements, business associate agreements, vendor agreements, data use agreements, data protection agreements, partnership agreements, non-disclosure agreements, and employment-related agreements.

- Maintain and improve contract templates, approval matrices, and internal guidance relating to transactional issues.

- Manage and develop transactional processes, including contract lifecycle management, to boost efficiency and support greater scale.

- Advise internal stakeholders, primarily on commercial transactions but also on other day-to-day legal issues and challenges as needed.

What you will bring to the team:

- 4+ years of experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating commercial agreements.

- A J.D. from a U.S. law school and admitted to a state bar. 

- No fear of technical, financial, or data science concepts.

- A willingness to “roll up your sleeves” and do whatever is necessary to ensure company success.

- Ideally, experience working in a rapidly-evolving startup environment and a desire to support our mission to improve the U.S. healthcare system.

Compensation Transparency:

The base salary range for this position is $210,000 - $230,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health and more.

title: Senior Marketing Counsel
posting_excerpt:
e of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Senior Counsel- Marketing to join Harvey's growing legal team. In this role you will be the primary legal point of contact for all marketing and communications activity at Harvey. You will also assist with the contracts and commercial relationships that power our marketing engine, safeguard the integrity of our promotional messaging, and act as a hands-on partner to the teams driving Harvey's growth. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a commercially minded lawyer who wants to sit at the intersection of law, brand, and go-to-market strategy.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Review and advise on marketing language across all promotional material, product announcements, including web copy, advertising, social media, email campaigns, sales enablement content, and event and press materials, to ensure claims are accurate, substantiated, and compliant.

 - Balance commercial, marketing, compliance, and privacy concerns across advertising campaigns (US and internationally).

 - Advise on targeted and digital advertising practices, including the data, privacy, tracking of direct to consumer marketing such as email marketing.

 - Act as the embedded legal partner to Marketing and Comms leadership, providing practical, business-oriented guidance that enables campaigns to launch quickly and responsibly.

 - Partner closely with cross-functional teams to keep pace in a fast-moving environment, knowing when to move independently and when to escalate matters to the right internal stakeholders.

 - Collaborate with the commercial team on global marketing agreements.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - J.D. and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

 - 8+ years of relevant experience at a law firm and/or in-house, with meaningful exposure to marketing, advertising, and commercial contracting.

 - Strong command of advertising and marketing law, including claims substantiation, and consumer protection.

 - Working knowledge of privacy and data protection issues relevant to targeted advertising and direct-to-consumer marketing.

 - Demonstrated ability to draft and negotiate a high volume of marketing commercial agreements independently.

 - Excellent judgment, a business-first mindset, and the ability to give clear, practical advice under tight timelines.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and partnering closely with non-legal stakeholders.




COMPENSATION

$210,300 - $281,500 USD

Key Responsibilities

 - Lead corporate governance for Perplexity and its subsidiaries, including board and committee meeting preparation, agendas, minutes, resolutions and written consents, charters, organizational documents, corporate policies, and the corporate records that keep the company well-governed as it scales.

 - Monitor legal and market developments affecting private-company governance, equity, and securities matters, and translate them into practical guidance for the executive team and the board.

 - Strong business acumen and ability to partner with finance, accounting, people, and executive stakeholders

 - An ability to communicate clearly with business and technical audiences and effectively translate legal concepts for non-lawyers

 - Hands-on attitude to tackle projects large and small, low-ego approach to working across the organization

 - Positive collaborative attitude, comfort with change and a fast pace, high level of integrity, and intellectual curiosity

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
